'''Sting''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Kentron" (archive ID: ARL121) would charge pieces of itself with energy and propel them with inertial launching. The energy efficiency of this mechanism is extremely low.}}

==Overview==
As one of the basic ranged [[Aggeloi]], Stings are more of a fodder enemy; Their only attack is a shot from their tail that deals Physical damage.
